desc:
Give your cat a collar as sweet as they are. The Orlivane Personalized Cat Collar pairs a soft pink velvet strap with a matching velvet bow and a jingle bell, then adds your cat's name with laser engraving on the rose gold buckle. Type the name in the customization box, and we'll make it to order.

Specifications:
- Material: velvet strap with soft lining; metal buckle; bell
- Bow: about 8 × 4 cm (3.1 × 1.6 in)
- Buckle finish: rose gold
- Adjustable length: about 16–26 cm (6.3–10.2 in)
- Engraving: laser-engraved on the metal buckle

Safety: Check the fit regularly; you should be able to slip two fingers under the collar. Remove the collar if it catches on anything.
b: ENGRAVED WITH YOUR CAT'S NAME — Enter your cat's name and we laser-engrave it on the buckle, so everyone knows who this little one belongs to. Each collar is made to order.
SOFT VELVET, SWEET BOW — A plush pink velvet strap with a soft inner lining feels gentle on fur, and the matching velvet bow (about 8 × 4 cm) makes every day look dressed up.
JINGLE BELL — The small bell lets you hear where your cat is around the house and helps you find a hiding kitten.
ROSE GOLD BUCKLE — The metal buckle clicks closed and opens easily. Adjusts from about 6.3 to 10.2 in.
A GIFT CAT PARENTS LOVE — A thoughtful present for new kittens, birthdays, adoption days and holidays. Please measure your cat's neck before ordering and supervise your cat while it wears any collar.
